source_refs.note: Fission Chain Reaction: a main subheading of 19.2 Nuclear Fission, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 141-143.

blocks.text: Fission mein uranium-235 ka nucleus ek neutron absorb (jazb) kar ke taqreeban barabar mass ke do nuclei mein toot'ta hai aur saath do ya teen neutrons bhi nikalta hai. In neutrons ko theek tarah istemal karein to yeh aur zyada uranium atoms mein fission karte hain, aur reaction khud ba khud chalta rehta hai. Ise fission chain reaction kehte hain. Farz karein hamare paas ²³⁵₉₂U ki kuch quantity (miqdar) hai aur kisi source ka ek slow neutron ek uranium atom mein fission karta hai, jis se taqreeban teen neutrons nikalte hain. Conditions (halaat) theek hon to yeh aur atoms mein fission karte hain. Is tarah yeh process bohat tezi se barhta hai aur bohat hi kam waqt mein bohat zyada energy aur zabardast dhamaka paida hota hai. Fig. 19.3 fission chain reaction dikhati hai.

blocks.alt: Shaakhon wali chain (zanjeer): aik fissile nucleus do fission neutrons do nuclei ko bhejta hai, har aik do mazeed ko (chaar), aur woh aath ko. Har neutron teer par nucleus se pehle chhota dot (nuqta) hai. Labels: Fission neutrons, Fissile nuclei.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.3: fission chain reaction (kitab ki Figure 19.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Figure mein har fission do neutrons chhorta hai aur har neutron agla fission karta hai, is liye nuclei 1, 2, 4, 8 ki tarah dugne hote jate hain. Yahi uncontrolled (be-qaboo) chain reaction hai jo atom bomb mein hota hai.

Aise halaat bhi banaye ja sakte hain jin mein ek fission ke tamam neutrons mein se sirf ek neutron agla fission kare; baqi neutrons bahar nikal jayen ya uranium ke ilawa kisi aur cheez mein absorb (jazb) ho jayen. Tab chain reaction apni shuru wali speed se hi chalta rehta hai. Fig. 19.4 dekhein: (a) fissile material (fission hone wala maddah) (jaise enriched uranium-235) ki patli sheet (chadar) mein fission ke neutrons hawa mein bikhar jate hain, is liye chain reaction nahi hota. (b) Kuch behtar halaat hain: pehle fission ke kuch neutrons sirf ek aur fission karte hain, lekin chain reaction phir bhi nahi banta. (c) Zyada tar uranium-235 wala ek spherical lump (gol tukda) hai; agar yeh kafi bara ho to fission ke zyada tar neutrons bahar nikalne se pehle hi absorb ho jate hain aur chain reaction chalta hai.

blocks.alt: (a) 235U ki patli sheet (chadar): neutron dakhil hota, fission hota aur neutrons (n) sheet se bahar nikal jate. (b) 235U ka U-shakal tukra: aane wala neutron fission (dot) karta; aik neutron doosri arm (baazu) mein doosra fission karta aur baqi (n) nikal jate. (c) 235U ka sphere (gola): aane wala neutron fissions (dots) shuru karta jin ke neutrons andar mazeed fissions karte; kuch neutrons bahar nikal jate.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.4: (a) patli sheet (chadar), (b) U-shakal tukra, (c) 235U ka sphere (gola) (kitab ki Figure 19.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: (a) Patli sheet mein fission ke neutrons foran bahar nikal jate hain, chain reaction nahi hota. (b) U-shakal mein aik neutron doosra fission karta hai, phir bhi zyada tar neutrons bahar nikal jate hain. (c) Kafi bare sphere (gole) mein zyada tar neutrons bahar nikalne se pehle doosre nuclei mein fission karte hain, is liye chain reaction chalta hai. Kitab (c) mein 235 ko neeche (subscript) chhapti hai; sahi 235U (oopar) hai.

blocks.title: Critical mass
blocks.text: Uranium ka woh mass jis mein ek fission ke tamam neutrons mein se ek neutron agla fission kare, critical mass kehlata hai.

Is mass ka volume (hajm) critical volume ya size kehlata hai. Agar uranium ka mass critical mass se bohat zyada ho to chain reaction bohat tezi se chalta hai aur zabardast dhamaka hota hai; atom bomb isi principle (usool) par kaam karta hai. Agar mass critical mass se kam ho to chain reaction nahi chalta. Agar mass critical mass ke barabar ho to chain reaction ek hi speed se chalta rehta hai aur energy ka steady (barabar milne wala) source milta hai; atomic reactor mein energy isi principle se li jati hai. Reactor mein chain reaction ko atom bomb ki tarah be-qaboo nahi hone diya jata, balke cadmium ki rods (salakhon) se control kiya jata hai jo reactor mein dali jati hain. Cadmium bohat se neutrons absorb (jazb) kar sakta hai aur khud unstable ya radioactive nahi banta. Control rods andar dalne se fission ke liye available (maujood) neutrons kam ho jate hain, aur is tarah fission reaction control mein rehta hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Controlled chain reaction mein har fission ka average (ausatan) sirf ek neutron agle nucleus mein fission karta hai. Is liye energy ek steady (barabar), controlled rate se nikalti hai.

blocks.alt: Neutron uranium nucleus se takrata hai. Do neutrons nikalte hain: aik 'Absorbed neutron', doosra agle uranium nucleus tak jata; woh phir aik absorbed neutron aur aik aage jane wala deta hai jo teesre nucleus tak pohanchta; teesra bhi aik jazb shuda aur aik aage jane wala neutron deta hai.
blocks.caption: Kya aap jante hain? box: controlled chain reaction mein har fission ka average sirf aik neutron agla fission karta hai (kitab ke box ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har fission ke baad sirf aik neutron agle uranium nucleus tak jata hai; baqi neutrons control rods ya doosre materials mein absorb (jazb) ho jate hain. Is tarah reaction ki speed barabar rehti hai aur energy steady rate (barabar raftar) se milti hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 g uranium-235 ke poore fission mein, 200 MeV per fission ke hisaab se, kitni energy nikalti hai?
blocks.explanation: Nuclei ka number = (1/235) × 6.02 × 10²³ = 2.56 × 10²¹. Energy = 2.56 × 10²¹ × 200 MeV × 1.6 × 10⁻¹³ J/MeV = 8.2 × 10¹⁰ J. (1 g koyla jalane se sirf taqreeban 3 × 10⁴ J milti hai, yani fission taqreeban 30 lakh guna zyada energy deta hai.)

items: Fission: ²³⁵U + n → do tukde + 2 ya 3 neutrons + taqreeban 200 MeV (19.3-19.5).
Energy B.E per nucleon ke barhne (7.6 se 8.5 MeV) se: 235 × 0.9 = 211.5 MeV.
Chain reaction; critical mass; cadmium rods neutrons absorb kar ke reaction control karti hain.
